method.teacher_system: The teacher lists common beginner dance mistakes one by one and explains the negative effects of each. Then, the teacher provides actionable solutions and tips to help beginners improve their technique and mindset.

practices.what: Start with light cardio for 3 to 5 minutes, like jogging in place or jumping jacks, to increase heart rate and blood flow.
Break difficult moves down into smaller, manageable parts and focus on each section one at a time.

adaptations.difficulty: Being afraid to dance in public
adaptations.adjustment: Start small by dancing in low-pressure situations at home or with close friends who support you.

adaptations.difficulty: Relying too much on the mirror
adaptations.adjustment: Close your eyes for a few seconds during practice to rely more on body sensations rather than visual feedback.

beliefs.belief: Everyone is more focused on having a good time than judging your moves, so you can let loose.
